Meta.title: Guilherme Peres - Fullstack Developer
Meta.description: Fullstack developer based in São Paulo, Brazil. I work with TypeScript, Node.js, React and AWS, shipping systems to production - from financial platforms to internal ERPs.

About.headline: I'm a <hl>Fullstack Developer</hl> focused on <hl>automation and performance</hl>
About.text: I work from back end to front end, including databases and cloud infrastructure. My focus is AI applied to real products, always on a solid foundation of architecture, DDD and design systems, which I have been applying from my studies to my professional work.
About.textShort: I work from back end to front end, including databases and cloud. My focus is AI applied to real products.

anka-tech.description: I'm part of the team that builds platforms for BTG Pactual accredited firms. Among many deliveries, I created AI agents that automate the advisors' daily work and the engine that calculates each advisor's monthly commission with configurable rules.

audax-electronics.description: I built the ERP that connects the company's production, purchasing, logistics and controllership. I also created the pipeline that syncs TOTVS Protheus automatically, saving the IT team 4 hours a day, and cut report generation from 30 minutes to seconds.

soc.description: I provided technical support over chat and phone to users of SOC, an occupational health and safety software. I also organized ticket logging and escalation, which made every request easier to track.

Projects.title: Projects
Projects.rpgforge-ai: An AI-powered RPG character sheet platform that turns a free-text description into a complete sheet, ready to play. All content comes from the system's official rules, and a custom rules engine checks every calculation.
Projects.manga-stars: A social network for rating manga, with star ratings and comments from the community. Search by title or author, genre filters and a feed of recent reviews help every reader find the next story to read.
